name: Frontera Funds SKaaS — FIC Funds Intelligence
description: Frontera Funds-branded institutional analysis and HTML reporting service for Colombian FICs, with standardized factsheets, peer comparisons, optional SFC data, MCP analytics and categorization snapshots.
author: Jairo Alonso González

service_profile.service_outcome: Produce an evidence-led, standardized Spanish-language HTML factsheet or peer-comparison report for Colombian collective investment funds, supported by structured findings and source provenance.

separate_library_when: substantial reusable data-processing or analytics functionality is needed
functionality requires independent release and maintenance

integration_requirements.access_policy: The host must verify source access, licensing, entitlements and permissions for each invocation. Frontera Funds is the product brand; the private SaaS implementation is not a runtime dependency.

output_contract.consistency_policy: Required report profile sections, metric definitions, cutoff, provenance, category treatment, disclosures and validation remain stable across compatible models. Narrative analysis may differ but must follow evidence and uncertainty rules.

model_portability.target: Compatible Agent Skills hosts and models
model_portability.guarantee: Standardized service contract, report structures and validation expectations; not identical model reasoning or prose.

commercialization.note: Portable package does not include hosted execution, licensed data, service support, pricing or SLA.

runtime_requirements.python: optional for the lightweight HTML artifact validator; not required to read the methodology or reason over supplied data
runtime_requirements.network: required only for live external source retrieval
runtime_requirements.file_generation: requires writable host artifact capability or a user-supplied HTML artifact
runtime_requirements.external_data_access: authorized public data, MCP, API, browser, user-supplied file or licensed provider

frontera_funds_saas.approved_brand_assets: Supplied separately through an authorized brand package
frontera_funds_saas.report_quality_standard: Institutional report quality and visual identity parity

branding.identity_standard: Frontera Funds official brand identity and approved report design system
branding.logo_policy: Use the official logo from an authorized brand asset package supplied to the runtime; never recreate or infer it. If unavailable, use the approved text wordmark fallback and emit a warning.
branding.implementation_boundary: Brand and report-quality consistency do not imply code, API, infrastructure, credential or runtime dependency on the private Frontera Funds SaaS.

data_dependencies.name: SFC FIC open-data dataset qhpu-8ixx
data_dependencies.freshness: Capture latest cutoff and retrieval time on every live-data invocation

data_dependencies.name: FIC categorization snapshot
data_dependencies.freshness: Use snapshot's own cutoff and version; never assume latest is current without verification

evaluation.report_ref: 4 HTML validator tests passed locally; Draft 2020-12 output schema validated against a factsheet fixture. Full factory CI and cross-model tests not yet run.
limitations: No production connector or browser export has been tested from this Skill.
Domain analysis quality and investment suitability are not certified.
evaluation.scope: Local unit tests for the lightweight HTML validator and schema validation only.

runtime_compatibility.surface: Standard-library HTML artifact validator and tests
runtime_compatibility.evidence_ref: 4 unit tests passed; Draft 2020-12 domain output schema validated

runtime_compatibility.surface: Native Skill discovery and optional tool integration
